description: The one Rostock rectangle every part of Mini Rostock 3D works with: the bounds of the city limits (OSM relation 62405, the Kreisfreie Stadt Rostock) widened by paddingMeters on all four sides, in WGS84 degrees. Read by src/lib/rostock-bounding-box.ts (the app, the data pipeline scripts, the dev server, the E2E tests) and by server/api/ais.php, which gets a copy next to it on deploy (ci.yml). boundingBox is derived from cityBounds and paddingMeters; tests/rostock-bounding-box.test.ts recomputes it and names the right numbers when the two disagree.
